model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Official Turbo INT8 · 8 Steps
model.description: Official Qwen 2.1 Turbo checkpoint, released October 9, 2026. Unified text-to-image and editing, native 2K, RGBA and up to 10 references. Comfy-Org INT8 ConvRot weights with the official fixed eight-step schedule and CFG 1. Quality depends on the prompt; compare with the 40-step base.
model.selector_help: Official Qwen Turbo, separate from Viggle six-step LoRA. Reuses the Qwen3-VL encoder and Qwen 2.1 VAE; downloads a separate ~7.3 GB INT8 transformer on first use. Uses the saved eight-step sigmas without resolution shifting. Do not stack acceleration LoRAs. Optional fast alternative; the 40-step base remains the default. Use Auto VAE tiling for native 2K on a 24 GB GPU.

resource_requirements.note: Shares the base encoder and VAE. 24 GB GPU recommended for native 2K; use 1K on smaller GPUs. Separate INT8 checkpoint, no adapter.
